item.title: Apple outage: iPhone maker rules out cyberattack, says most systems restored after internal update caused disruption
item.description: Apple reported widespread service disruptions after an internal update affected iCloud, Apple Pay and other services, but said most systems have been restored. The outage follows recent glitches affecting Microsoft, US flights and major banks, raising concerns over service reliability.

item.description: Thousands of Apple users in the US reported problems with iCloud, App Store, Apple Pay and Apple Music on November 17. Here's what happened and which services were affected.

item.title: eMudhra fixes emBridge security flaw after CERT-In warns of file-system metadata exposure
item.description: CERT-In flagged a low-severity vulnerability in eMudhra’s emBridge utility affecting certain computer OS versions. An unauthenticated attacker on the same network could enumerate file and directory names, but not access or alter files, run code, or obtain cryptographic keys or token PINs.

item.title: What is iQOO 15's 4th-gen silicon anode battery technology and how does it promise longer gaming and streaming hours?
item.description: The iQOO 15 uses fourth-generation silicon anode technology in its 7,000mAh battery. The company claims it can deliver up to 10.5 hours of gaming, 32.6 hours of video streaming and 22.6 hours of social media use.&nbsp;

item.title: How do PC, PlayStation and Xbox prices compare? Assassin’s Creed Shadows costs up to ₹8,399 in India
item.description: Assassin's Creed Shadows is priced differently across PC, PlayStation and Xbox in India, with its Premium Edition costing up to ₹8,399. A long-time fan explains whether its new features, stealth mechanics and story justify the high price.

item.title: GTA 6 hacker Arion Kurtaj, who breached Rockstar with Amazon Fire Stick, pleads guilty: What happens next?
item.description: Arion Kurtaj, the hacker behind the 2022 Rockstar Games breach that leaked 90 clips of unfinished GTA 6 gameplay, has pleaded guilty to multiple cybercrimes after being released from a secure hospital.

item.title: Cyberattack hits 178 websites including CNN, BBC, Fox News and Zoom; iPhone users also targeted
item.description: A cyberattack exploited Optimizely to deliver malicious JavaScript across 178 websites, including CNN, BBC, Fox News, Zoom and HSBC. The malware targeted cryptocurrency wallets, payment card details and browser data, while also deploying iOS exploits to compromise vulnerable iPhones and iPads.

item.description: Apple has introduced a camera-based face unlock feature for the iPhone Duo with the iOS 27.3 developer beta, addressing a major complaint about its reliance on Touch ID.

item.title: OPPO Reno 17, Reno 17 Pro launched with up to 8,000mAh battery, 200MP camera: Price, specifications
item.description: OPPO has launched the Reno 17 and Reno 17 Pro in China, featuring up to 8,000mAh batteries, 50MP periscope telephoto cameras and up to a 200MP primary camera. Prices start at CNY 3,599 (around ₹51,000), while an India launch timeline is yet to be confirmed.

item.description: A software defect that remained dormant for months, a routine network failover and a temporary reduction in server capacity collectively triggered a global outage.

item.title: AI stocks face correction risk as US Fed flags Big Tech debt, rising data centre costs and stretched valuations
item.description: The US Federal Reserve has flagged rising debt, circular financing and stretched valuations in the AI sector as financial stability risks. A slowdown in AI returns could trigger a stock market correction and expose lenders and investors to losses.

item.title: Motorola Signature 27 battery controversy: Why could some buyers get a 5,500mAh battery instead of 7,000mAh?
item.description: Motorola Signature 27 is advertised with a 7,000mAh battery, but EU regulatory records show another variant with a 5,500mAh unit. The difference has raised questions about regional specifications and what buyers can expect.

item.title: Intel Core Ultra 7 260K arrives as a limited-edition CPU: Why is the new Arrow Lake processor hard to buy separately?
item.description: Intel has confirmed the Core Ultra 7 260K as a limited-availability desktop processor. The 20-core Arrow Lake chip is currently available through select Newegg ABS gaming desktops, but buyers cannot purchase it separately as a boxed CPU.

item.title: China flies 19-seater battery-powered aircraft for first time: How far can it travel?
item.description: China's 19-seat CE-25A electric passenger aircraft, developed by COMAC and partners including CATL, has completed its first piloted flight in Shandong. The 10-tonne aircraft offers a range of around 400 km and a cruising speed of 300 kmph.&nbsp;

item.title: Mint Explainer | Why recent tech failures trigger concerns over digital resilience
item.description: A Microsoft outage and a FAA ground stop in the US unfolded within hours, prompting questions about the resilience of digital and AI-led automated systems. How vulnerable are critical services in an increasingly interconnected digital world?
